newsitem.title: USA: Petroecuador seeks 2.6 mln bbls diesel from June.
newsitem.headline: Petroecuador seeks 2.6 mln bbls diesel from June.

text.p: Ecuador's state oil company Petroecuador is seeking to buy 2.6 million barrels of diesel fuel for delivery from June to December in its latest tender for refined products, trade sources said on Tuesday.
The unusually high volume of diesel is slated to cover the planned shutdown of Petroecuador's Esmeraldas refinery from mid-June until mid-August.
The shutdown is part of a plan to expand the refinery's processing capacity to 110,000 barrels per day (bpd) from a current 90,000 bpd, trade sources said.
The expansion is slated for completion in mid-August.
Petroecuador is seeking to buy diesel with a sulfur content of 0.8 percent.
